method: Complete official Pinterest and Slack privacy text extracted by scripts/prepare-real-policies-round16.py; one reviewer froze document-category labels and questions before inference; source text stays in gitignored .cache/real_policies_round16.
annotationNotes: Pinterest's current policy says it continues processing contacts previously synced; this affirms retention of already shared contacts, not a current device-address-book import. Contacts is negative under the existing classifier definition.

Pinterest explicitly trains machine-learning and generative-AI models with Pins, including a body-type technology trained on images; body-type processing is not identity recognition and biometric remains negative.

Slack explicitly describes optional device/API address-book import, targeted ads on non-Slack sites, and retention of Other Information after deactivation. Its policy does not affirm AI model training.
Advertising is positive for both publishers; location, outside sharing, and retention are positive for all four localized pages.
